grammar.pattern: 敢 + 动词：勇气与意愿
grammar.purpose: Separate willingness from ability and permission
grammar.explanation: 敢说 expresses daring to speak despite hesitation. 不敢 says the courage is lacking; it does not prove the person cannot speak or is prohibited. 敢不敢试？ asks willingness; 能不能试？ may ask ability or permission in context. Do not pressure a refusal: 可以先听 allows a gradual start.

examples.py: wǒ bù gǎn shuō , dàn tīng de dǒng .
examples.en: I do not dare speak, but can understand.

examples.py: gǎn bù gǎn xiān shì yī jù ?
examples.en: Would you dare try one sentence first?

examples.zh: 现在不想试，也可以先听。
examples.py: xiàn zài bù xiǎng shì , yě kě yǐ xiān tīng .
examples.en: If you do not want to try now, you may listen first.

commonMistakes.right: 不敢说不一定是不会说。
commonMistakes.why: Courage, competence and permission are separate meanings.

grammar.pattern: 谁都 / 哪儿都 / 疑问词呼应 / 不定指
grammar.purpose: Read a question word used without a question
grammar.explanation: 谁都可以先来听 means everyone is permitted to listen; 谁可以来听？ asks who may attend. 你想读什么，就读什么 links the selected object across clauses. 我想问你什么事 is unnatural for the intended vague sense; 我想问你点儿什么 can mean something unspecified, while 我想问你一件事 is clearer. Scope matters: 谁都 can be narrowed by the notice, and 谁都不 says nobody.

examples.py: shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
examples.en: Anyone may come and listen first.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng dú shén me , jiù dú shén me .
examples.en: Read whatever you want to read.

examples.zh: 今天哪儿都不去，就在这里。
examples.py: jīn tiān nǎr dōu bù qù , jiù zài zhè lǐ .

commonMistakes.right: 谁都不去，就是没有人去。
commonMistakes.why: The negation changes an inclusive claim to nobody.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 今天谁都可以来听吗？我没报比赛。
lines.py: jīn tiān shéi dōu kě yǐ lái tīng ma ? wǒ méi bào bǐ sài .
lines.en: Can anyone listen today? I haven't entered the competition.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，今天是读书活动，比赛是下个月的事。
lines.py: kě yǐ , jīn tiān shì dú shū huó dòng , bǐ sài shì xià gè yuè de shì .
lines.en: Yes. Today is a reading event. The competition is next month.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那就好。我有点害怕在很多人面前读。
lines.py: nà jiù hǎo . wǒ yǒu diǎn hài pà zài hěn duō rén miàn qián dú .
lines.en: Good. I'm a little afraid of reading in front of lots of people.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你先和我坐一桌，想读什么就选什么。
lines.py: nǐ xiān hé wǒ zuò yī zhuō , xiǎng dú shén me jiù xuǎn shén me .
lines.en: Sit at my table first. Choose whatever you'd like to read.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这两篇的难度差不多吗？
lines.py: zhè liǎng piān de nán dù chà bu duō ma ?
lines.en: Are these two passages about equally difficult?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 左边的短一点。我上次读过，还挺有意思。
lines.py: zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn . wǒ shàng cì dú guò , hái tǐng yǒu yì si .
lines.en: The one on the left is shorter. I've read it before; it's interesting.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我先选这篇，先听你读一遍。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiān xuǎn zhè piān , xiān tīng nǐ dú yī biàn .
lines.en: I'll pick that one and listen to you read it first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。每个人读一小段，轮到你还早呢。
lines.py: xíng . měi gè rén dú yī xiǎo duàn , lún dào nǐ hái zǎo ne .
lines.en: Sure. We each read a short section. It'll be a while before your turn.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这里有各种书，我还想看看旁边那本。
lines.py: zhè lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng shū , wǒ hái xiǎng kàn kàn páng biān nà běn .
lines.en: There are all sorts of books here. I'd like to look at the one beside it too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 等这段读完再看吧。时间足够，不用急。
lines.py: děng zhè duàn dú wán zài kàn ba . shí jiān zú gòu , bù yòng jí .
lines.en: Let's finish this section first. There's enough time; no rush.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我读第一句，你帮我听听？
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ dú dì yī jù , nǐ bāng wǒ tīng tīng ?
lines.en: Okay, shall I read the first sentence while you listen?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 来吧。我听着，你慢慢读。
lines.py: lái ba . wǒ tīng zhe , nǐ màn màn dú .
lines.en: Go ahead. I'm listening; take your time.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Read the scope before joining
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周末的读书活动对大家开放。我没有报名下个月的比赛，还是可以参加今天的活动。门口有一群人在选书，我站在后面看了一会儿。
lines.py: zhōu mò de dú shū huó dòng duì dà jiā kāi fàng . wǒ méi yǒu bào míng xià gè yuè de bǐ sài , hái shi kě yǐ cān jiā jīn tiān de huó dòng . mén kǒu yǒu yī qún rén zài xuǎn shū , wǒ zhàn zài hòu miàn kàn le yī huì er .
lines.en: The weekend reading event was open to everyone. I hadn't entered next month's competition, but I could join today's activity. A group was choosing books at the entrance, and I watched for a while.

lines.zh: 陈宇看见我，把我带到他的桌子旁边。桌上放着两篇文章，他说左边的短一点，自己上次读过。
lines.py: chén yǔ kàn jiàn wǒ , bǎ wǒ dài dào tā de zhuō zi páng biān . zhuō shàng fàng zhe liǎng piān wén zhāng , tā shuō zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn , zì jǐ shàng cì dú guò .
lines.en: Chen Yu saw me and brought me to his table. There were two passages on it. The left one was shorter, and he'd read it before.

lines.zh: 我选了短的那篇，想先听别人读。他给我指了第一段，我一边听，一边用手跟着字走。
lines.py: wǒ xuǎn le duǎn de nà piān , xiǎng xiān tīng bié ren dú . tā gěi wǒ zhǐ le dì yī duàn , wǒ yī biān tīng , yī biān yòng shǒu gēn zhe zì zǒu .
lines.en: I chose the shorter one and wanted to listen first. He pointed to the first paragraph, and I followed the characters with my finger while listening.

lines.zh: 轮到我时，我读了第一句。声音不太大，陈宇把椅子往我这边挪了一点，说这样听得更清楚。
lines.py: lún dào wǒ shí , wǒ dú le dì yī jù . shēng yīn bù tài dà , chén yǔ bǎ yǐ zi wǎng wǒ zhè biān nuó le yī diǎn , shuō zhè yàng tīng de gèng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: When my turn came I read the first sentence. I was quiet, so Chen Yu moved his chair closer and said he could hear more clearly that way.

lines.zh: 后来各桌开始聊天，每个人说自己喜欢哪一段。旁边一位朋友喜欢结尾，我喜欢开头，两个人又一起看了一遍。
lines.py: hòu lái gè zhuō kāi shǐ liáo tiān , měi gè rén shuō zì jǐ xǐ huān nǎ yī duàn . páng biān yī wèi péng you xǐ huān jié wěi , wǒ xǐ huān kāi tóu , liǎng gè rén yòu yì qǐ kàn le yī biàn .
lines.en: Later the tables began chatting about favourite sections. Someone beside me liked the ending; I liked the beginning. We looked through it together again.

lines.zh: 回去的路上，我问陈宇下周还有没有活动。他说有，我就把时间记下来。这次只读了一句，下次想试试一整段。
lines.py: huí qù de lù shàng , wǒ wèn chén yǔ xià zhōu hái yǒu méi yǒu huó dòng . tā shuō yǒu , wǒ jiù bǎ shí jiān jì xià lái . zhè cì zhǐ dú le yī jù , xià cì xiǎng shì shì yī zhěng duàn .
lines.en: On the way home I asked if there was another event next week. There was, so I wrote down the time. I'd read one sentence this time and wanted to try a whole paragraph next time.

choices: The narrator reads one sentence and wants to return
questions.answer: The narrator reads one sentence and wants to return

choices: To hear the quiet reader more clearly
To get closer to the exit

choices: The narrator plans to try a whole paragraph next time

lines.zh: 你刚才读得比我大声。
lines.py: nǐ gāng cái dú de bǐ wǒ dà shēng .
lines.en: You read louder than me just now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 因为你坐得近，我不用往后面喊。
lines.py: yīn wèi nǐ zuò de jìn , wǒ bù yòng wǎng hòu miàn hǎn .
lines.en: You were nearby, so I didn't have to shout to the back.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下次也坐这儿吧？
lines.py: xià cì yě zuò zhèr ba ?
lines.en: Shall we sit here next time too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，不过你得早点来，别让我一直留着椅子。
lines.py: xíng , bù guò nǐ děi zǎo diǎn lái , bié ràng wǒ yì zhí liú zhe yǐ zi .
lines.en: Sure, but come early. Don't make me save the chair forever.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我给椅子也带一杯茶。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ gěi yǐ zi yě dài yī bēi chá .
lines.en: Okay, I'll bring tea for the chair too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 给我就行，椅子喝不了。
lines.py: gěi wǒ jiù xíng , yǐ zi hē bù le .
lines.en: Give it to me. The chair can't drink.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 两个人各买了一杯茶。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén gè mǎi le yī bēi chá .
lines.en: They each bought a cup of tea.

lines.zh: 我每天走路上班。
lines.py: wǒ měi tiān zǒu lù shàng bān .
lines.en: I walk to work every day.

lines.zh: 每张桌子上都有一瓶水。
lines.py: měi zhāng zhuō zi shàng dōu yǒu yī píng shuǐ .
lines.en: There is a bottle of water on every table.

lines.zh: 有任何问题都可以问我。
lines.py: yǒu rèn hé wèn tí dōu kě yǐ wèn wǒ .
lines.en: You can ask me any questions.

lines.zh: 他没有带任何行李。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu dài rèn hé xíng lǐ .
lines.en: He didn't bring any luggage.

lines.zh: 我不敢一个人走那条黑路。
lines.py: wǒ bù gǎn yī gè rén zǒu nà tiáo hēi lù .
lines.en: I don't dare walk down that dark road alone.

lines.zh: 她敢在大家面前唱歌。
lines.py: tā gǎn zài dà jiā miàn qián chàng gē .
lines.en: She dares to sing in front of everyone.

lines.zh: 孩子害怕突然响的声音。
lines.py: hái zi hài pà tū rán xiǎng de shēng yīn .
lines.en: The child is afraid of sudden loud noises.

lines.zh: 我有点害怕，但还是想试试。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn hài pà , dàn hái shi xiǎng shì shì .
lines.en: I'm a little frightened, but I still want to try.

lines.zh: 车还没来，怕是要晚一点了。
lines.py: chē hái méi lái , pà shì yào wǎn yī diǎn le .
lines.en: The bus hasn't come; it will probably be a little late.

lines.zh: 这么多人排队，怕是还得等半小时。
lines.py: zhè me duō rén pái duì , pà shì hái děi děng bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: With this many people queuing, I suspect we'll wait another half-hour.

lines.zh: 我很好奇，她怎么找到这家店的？
lines.py: wǒ hěn hào qí , tā zěn me zhǎo dào zhè jiā diàn de ?
lines.en: I'm curious: how did she find this shop?

lines.zh: 孩子对新来的老师很好奇。
lines.py: hái zi duì xīn lái de lǎo shī hěn hào qí .
lines.en: The children are curious about the new teacher.

lines.zh: 这个字很容易写错。
lines.py: zhè gè zì hěn róng yì xiě cuò .
lines.en: This character is easy to write incorrectly.

lines.zh: 椅子放这里容易挡住门。
lines.py: yǐ zi fàng zhè lǐ róng yì dǎng zhù mén .
lines.en: A chair here could easily block the door.

lines.zh: 这次练习的难度比上次高。
lines.py: zhè cì liàn xí de nán dù bǐ shàng cì gāo .
lines.en: This exercise is harder than the previous one.

lines.zh: 我先选难度低一点的路。
lines.py: wǒ xiān xuǎn nán dù dī yī diǎn de lù .
lines.en: I'll choose an easier route first.

lines.zh: 她有把复杂事情讲清楚的能力。
lines.py: tā yǒu bǎ fù zá shì qíng jiǎng qīng chǔ de néng lì .
lines.en: She can explain complicated things clearly.

lines.zh: 我的听力能力还需要练习。
lines.py: wǒ de tīng lì néng lì hái xū yào liàn xí .
lines.en: My listening still needs practice.

lines.zh: 她的音乐才能从小就很突出。
lines.py: tā de yīn yuè cái néng cóng xiǎo jiù hěn tū chū .
lines.en: Her musical talent stood out from childhood.

lines.zh: 这项工作能发挥他的才能。
lines.py: zhè xiàng gōng zuò néng fā huī tā de cái néng .
lines.en: This work lets him use his talents.

lines.zh: 报名资格写在通知上。
lines.py: bào míng zī gé xiě zài tōng zhī shàng .
lines.en: The eligibility requirements are on the notice.

lines.zh: 他取得了参加比赛的资格。
lines.py: tā qǔ dé le cān jiā bǐ sài de zī gé .
lines.en: He qualified for the competition.

lines.zh: 三瓶水足够我们喝了。
lines.py: sān píng shuǐ zú gòu wǒ men hē le .
lines.en: Three bottles of water will be enough for us.

lines.zh: 时间还足够，别着急。
lines.py: shí jiān hái zú gòu , bié zháo jí .
lines.en: There's still enough time; don't rush.

lines.zh: 这两间房的价格标准不同。
lines.py: zhè liǎng jiān fáng de jià gé biāo zhǔn bù tóng .
lines.en: These two rooms have different pricing rates.

lines.zh: 老师给大家看了评分标准。
lines.py: lǎo shī gěi dà jiā kàn le píng fēn biāo zhǔn .
lines.en: The teacher showed everyone the marking criteria.

lines.zh: 活动结束后，名单会公开。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù hòu , míng dān huì gōng kāi .
lines.en: The list will be made public after the event.

lines.zh: 这是一次公开表演，谁都能来看。
lines.py: zhè shì yī cì gōng kāi biǎo yǎn , shéi dōu néng lái kàn .
lines.en: It's a public performance; anyone can watch.

lines.zh: 图书馆周末也开放。
lines.py: tú shū guǎn zhōu mò yě kāi fàng .
lines.en: The library is also open at weekends.

lines.zh: 这个房间暂时不向游客开放。
lines.py: zhè gè fáng jiān zàn shí bù xiàng yóu kè kāi fàng .
lines.en: This room is temporarily closed to visitors.

lines.zh: 各地的朋友都发来了照片。
lines.py: gè dì de péng you dōu fā lái le zhào piān .
lines.en: Friends from different places sent photos.

lines.zh: 他想尝尝各地的小吃。
lines.py: tā xiǎng cháng cháng gè dì de xiǎo chī .
lines.en: He wants to try snacks from different regions.

lines.zh: 各位请坐，活动马上开始。
lines.py: gè wèi qǐng zuò , huó dòng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ .
lines.en: Please take a seat, everyone. We're starting soon.

lines.zh: 谢谢各位今天来帮忙。
lines.py: xiè xiè gè wèi jīn tiān lái bāng máng .
lines.en: Thank you all for helping today.

lines.zh: 店里有各种颜色的杯子。
lines.py: diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng yán sè de bēi zi .
lines.en: The shop has cups in various colours.

lines.zh: 他尝试了各种办法，终于打开了门。
lines.py: tā cháng shì le gè zhǒng bàn fǎ , zhōng yú dǎ kāi le mén .
lines.en: He tried various methods and finally opened the door.

lines.zh: 吃完饭，我们各自回家。
lines.py: chī wán fàn , wǒ men gè zì huí jiā .
lines.en: After the meal we each went home.

lines.zh: 两位朋友各自带了一本书。
lines.py: liǎng wèi péng you gè zì dài le yī běn shū .
lines.en: The two friends each brought a book.

lines.zh: 请在这个范围内找座位。
lines.py: qǐng zài zhè gè fàn wéi nèi zhǎo zuò wèi .
lines.en: Please find a seat within this area.

lines.zh: 这本书介绍的范围很广。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiè shào de fàn wéi hěn guǎng .
lines.en: This book covers a wide range.

audio.zh: 左边的短一点。我上次读过，还挺有意思。
audio.py: zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn . wǒ shàng cì dú guò , hái tǐng yǒu yì si .
audio.en: The one on the left is shorter. I've read it before; it's interesting.

tasks.why: The heard line states this fact.

audio.zh: 回去的路上，我问陈宇下周还有没有活动。他说有，我就把时间记下来。这次只读了一句，下次想试试一整段。
audio.py: huí qù de lù shàng , wǒ wèn chén yǔ xià zhōu hái yǒu méi yǒu huó dòng . tā shuō yǒu , wǒ jiù bǎ shí jiān jì xià lái . zhè cì zhǐ dú le yī jù , xià cì xiǎng shì shì yī zhěng duàn .
audio.en: On the way home I asked if there was another event next week. There was, so I wrote down the time. I'd read one sentence this time and wanted to try a whole paragraph next time.

tasks.statement: The narrator decides not to return.
tasks.why: The heard line states a different outcome.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三03, 三07. Native check: 怕 adverbial cautious guesses in 这次怕不能马上开始 and 怕是要再等一会儿 versus the already-taught fear verb, 敢 versus 能/可以, 谁都 with negation and restricted scope, interrogative-word echo constructions, indefinite 点儿什么 and each versus all. Public participation is a fictional event arrangement, not a universal competition policy. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 二44 / 二63 / 二68: 她不但能读，而且能说。, 越练越清楚，还不是完美。, 因为分工清楚，所以没有重复做。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Early HSK 3 correction: warm introductions at a reading group, a hesitant reader taking a first turn, a one-hour volunteer handover and friends helping with messages and copying. Removed relationship-inference, unlimited-consent and assessment-policy cautions from ordinary speech. All 22 target records have two independent authored contexts, including formal or bound forms outside the casual scene. Preserved all old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: 老王 and 小李 forms of address; bound 者/员 and 志愿 application sense; 怕是 cautious prediction; colloquial 留个位子/接班 and quiet cat/chair teasing; 没收到 méi shōu dào rather than 没收 mò shōu; warmth versus familiarity in 亲切; 亲 as blood relation or closeness. Check every factual key against its own heard line. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
